coreDecision: Historical local amusement park at La Cabosse, Jurques, distinct visitor offering from successor Zoo de Jurques installed in1977. Four fresh official global Park/Standalone searches Cabosse/Jurques returned zero. Historical promotion explicitly names La Cabosse/Jurques route de Vire. Opening May1970 retained at month precision: secondary source Sunday conflicts with16May1970which was Saturday, no exact day invented. Closure1977 at year precision corresponds to sale/conversion; official zoo history corroborates relocation1977. Founding Lebel/Ozenne family names only in secondary history; exact legal operator unresolved, no shared founder/operator reference invented. Historical park footprint not precisely georeferenced; current zoo map centre not automatically reused. No current website/hours/prices and no zoo animals imported. Local audience conservative. Private ToReview. Original promotional card carries historical wordmark but is1.50MB and not a standalone logo; no cropping or recompression. Carousel archival image appears on a village street, no verified operating-park photo attribution; Surf Racing1970image is a small historical source.
